method.name: UseServiceProvider
method.summary: Use an external ServiceProvider for the Tool.
method.param: The external ServiceProvider to use.
Specifies whether the Tool owns and disposes the ServiceProvider.
method.remarks: When supplied, the external provider bypasses builder-owned Tool service configuration, including host lifetime registrations. Host builders therefore use the host's default lifetime and do not link a lifetime or connection into managed application services. The default ownership is Tool, causing the Tool to dispose the ServiceProvider.
